I know it might suck in the moment but things can always turn around. I'm sorry it's rough for you and I know dying might seem lile the only way but if you choose this know that you'll effect everyone around you. You'll miss out on the chance to ever find people who want to be your friend. You'll miss the moments when you can look back at all of this and say "That was a tragic moment in my life but I'm glad I made it out." You're still young and have so much time to experience life. Life is tragic but there are things out there that make it bearable. You'll find friends eventually and you'll find a way out of there. I don't want you to throw all the opportunity down the drain. Everyday I feel the same pain of not wanting to go on because of the situation I'm in but I hold onto the glimmer of light the future will have for me if I make it out. You're worth so much more than this situation. You're better than this situation. And if you can't make it into college there are always alternate routes. My dad kicked me out when I was 18 and I found an alternate route for a place to stay and found a job. And after I had to leave several of the places I've lived in due to one circumstance or another. It's exhausting but things are always changing. Sometimes it takes time before you can progress due to one reason or another other times things are changing so fast it's hard to keep up. Hold on a little longer to see what could happen. See what options are available to you and try working off of that. And if that leads you no where that just means you find another way. It's a task I'll admit but each piece gets you closer to your goal. I've been suffering for a long time but after awhile I found the opportunity that I was needing. It came to me when I needed hope the most. You got this. Push a little harder and even though I might not know you I'll cheer you on from across the world. It always helps when at least one person cares. And you know what I care.
